project_type: Python 3.11 modular app: Flask server-rendered web UI + CLI pipeline (Discover->Normalize->Deduplicate->Verify->Rank->Display). Being converted to a STATELESS SERVERLESS Vercel app: SQLite stays for local/dev, but the serverless request path + cross-session change-detection use a new SnapshotStore (Upstash Redis KV) holding only the previous run's canonical events per target date.
build_system: uv (uv sync --python 3.11 --extra dev) + Makefile. Deps in pyproject.toml + uv.lock. Add deps with `uv add <pkg>` (updates both). uv.lock IS gitignored; requirements.txt (exported via `uv export --no-dev --no-hashes -o requirements.txt`) is the COMMITTED manifest Vercel/pip uses.
test_framework: pytest (testpaths=['tests'], addopts='-ra -q'). Fully offline, deterministic, fixture-backed; NO live network in any test — mock all Upstash/Google HTTP clients.
test_command: make check  (runs: uv run ruff check . ; uv run black --check . ; uv run mypy ; uv run pytest). Individual: `uv run pytest tests/<file> -q`.
verification_instructions: Every new/changed module MUST pass ruff (select E,F,I,UP,B,W, line-length 88), black --check (line-length 88), mypy (strict=true, disallow_untyped_defs, no_implicit_optional), and pytest. Run `make check` for the full gate. BASELINE before this task: 93 tests pass, all green. Serverless boot check (offline, no env vars): `uv run python -c "import api.index as m; c=m.app.test_client(); r=c.get('/'); assert r.status_code==200 and b'Vandy Food Radar' in r.data"`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: store.db is generated by seeding and is gitignored (*.db). requirements.txt is GENERATED via `uv export --no-dev --no-hashes -o requirements.txt` and MUST be committed (Vercel Python uses pip; uv.lock is gitignored). No test snapshots.
environment_constraints: OFFLINE by default (Config.offline=True). No test may make a live network call: inject/mock all HTTP clients. Do NOT commit credentials or store.db. mypy is strict, so untyped Google libraries need a narrow `# type: ignore[import-untyped]` and MUST be imported lazily (inside a builder function) so offline imports never require the Google packages. Do NOT introduce Render, a persistent disk, APScheduler, or gunicorn — Vercel Cron replaces the in-process scheduler. Use stdlib urllib.request for Upstash + Google Maps HTTP (no `requests` dep); only Google Calendar pulls in google-api-python-client + google-auth. git remote origin = jingyu-ruan/vandy-food-radar; branch is 'master'; single worktree at /projects/sandbox (no separate worktree/branch created). Commit locally, never push.
contribution_requirements: Reuse existing interfaces VERBATIM; do NOT rewrite them. All new config flags default OFF/offline. App boots and serves with NO env vars set (offline/demo mode showing seeded fixtures so the page is never empty). Never auto-add events to calendar (FR-40) — only an explicitly selected event. Unknown walking uses the neutral ranking value, never zero (FR-30, AC-8), exactly as M6 does. Snapshot/KV outages degrade to 'no snapshot' (all events NEW), never an error. The SQLite-persistence + Render/APScheduler/gunicorn assumption (design.md §8 and .agents/tasks/m7-m9-plan.md) is SUPERSEDED by the stateless-serverless + Upstash-snapshot architecture — do NOT carry it forward.
key_patterns: Providers are typing.Protocols with concrete impls + a build_*_provider(config) selector (providers/location.py, providers/calendar.py). Config is nested @dataclass with defaults; Config.from_env layers VFR_-prefixed env overrides using _parse_bool/_parse_enum/_parse_float helpers, falling back to defaults on bad input. Pipeline run(window,*,repository,sources,location_provider,config)->RunReport; idempotent upsert keyed on Event.identity_key via SqliteRepository.save_event + find_by_identity_key; history via _diff_history over _TRACKED_FIELDS; value coercion via orchestrator._tracked_value (date/time->isoformat, StrEnum->.value). compute_identity_key(event_date,title) in dedup/deduplicator.py. Repository serializes children as JSON (see sqlite_repository._source_record_params/_conflict_params). Web create_app(config,*,repository,sources=None,location_provider=None,today_provider=None) injects collaborators and reads ONLY through Repository; wsgi.build_app() builds module-level `app` reading VFR_DB; templates in web/templates/{index.html,_event_card.html}; static in web/static/app.css. CLI cli.py:main builds sources via build_sources(config, default_fetcher(config)) and Window.from_config(config, today=datetime.now(tz=UTC).date()). Tests use SqliteRepository(':memory:'), seed_demo(...today=FIXED_TODAY=date(2025,3,10), TARGET_DAY=date(2025,3,11)), and a _SingleRecordAdapter class for change-detection (see tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py).
